selection_rule: Advanced settings chosen by mean training-only purged temporal-fold AP, Brier then shallower depth as tie-breaks. Replace strongest simpler model only for >=.01 absolute outer-validation AP improvement.
threshold_rule: Initial comparison uses .50 for all six. Exploratory per-model validation-F1 grid .01:.01:.99 retained separately; p>=threshold is positive.
validation_caveat: Reused historical validation for family comparison, threshold tuning and XAI: selected exploratory evidence, not independent final performance. Legacy settings were already selected on this validation in Days 9-10.
feature_transformations: Train-median imputation; log1p elapsed hours then train-standardization; first/second activity and UTC calendar categories train-one-hot, unknown -> zero indicators. No class weighting, resampling or post-hoc calibration.
test_policy: Locked: no test feature transformation, prediction, metrics or tuning. Only identifiers/split/time metadata checked.
limitations: Predictive associations do not establish causes, bottlenecks, inefficiency or intervention benefits.
Marginal shuffling/masking can combine correlated features unrealistically; importance may be shared or suppressed.
Empirical Shapley values depend on the fixed training background; exact coalitions do not remove background-sampling uncertainty.
Validation is reused for model selection, threshold exploration and XAI; test remains locked.
Recorded endpoints may be censored; landmark and overlap-purging exclusions restrict the population.

seed_stability.note: Permutation variation and seed sensitivity, not confidence intervals or an independent validation assessment.

xai.local_method: Exact grouped interventional Shapley, probability scale, all 64 coalitions
xai.library_note: Direct finite-coalition Shapley implementation avoids a new SHAP/numba dependency and keeps original-feature groups intact through the saved pipeline. This is not a claim that the SHAP package is incompatible.
